text: The purpose of this report is to advise of the results of Request for Tender Ariba Document Number 3754640010, Contract Number 22ECS-MI-03AB, for the D Building Phase 2 Upgrades project at Ashbridges Bay Treatment Plant and to request authority to award the contract to Bennett Mechanical Installations (2001) Limited in the amount of $75,275,157 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($76,600,000 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries).

The General Government Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 195-8.4A of the Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 195 (Purchasing), granted authority to award Contract Number 22ECS-MI-03AB, Ariba Document Number 3754640010, for D Building Phase 2 Upgrades project at Ashbridges Bay Treatment Plant, in the amount of $75,275,157 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($76,600,000 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries) to Bennett Mechanical Installations (2001) Limited having submitted the lowest compliant bid and meeting the specifications in conformance with the Tender requirements.
